Alex: Quick ping — opened PR #4821 to adjust KV prefetch window + batching heuristics. Needs one more approval to merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821
Mira: taking a look now. tl;dr: what's the expected perf change? rough numbers?
Alex: baseline 95th latency drops ~12% for short seqs (<=128), throughput up ~7% in our cpu-bound microbench. Memory overhead +2%. Ran local microbench, paste:
```
Seq=64 QPS=800 -> 95p 48ms -> now 42ms
Seq=128 QPS=500 -> 95p 84ms -> now 74ms
```
Ben: solid. did CI run integration tests against kv-prefetch? any flakiness?
